verdict.rationale: Mercury clearly supports invoice creation and sending with payment collection (manual/automatic invoices, flexible payment methods, ACH/card collection, invoice limits by plan) and an Accounts Receivable API for programmatic invoicing, but there is no explicit evidence of 'branded' invoices (custom logo/branding, templates) or of a finance-lead-facing UI for designing invoice appearance — most evidence is API/developer-oriented rather than a described finance-lead dashboard workflow. missing for 10: branding/customization evidence, direct UI walkthrough for finance-lead, independent/hands-on confirmation of invoicing feature.
